ns2:course.label: German for Economics
ns2:course.description: German language as used in professional contexts involving economic matters: texts and documents relating to forms of enterprises and their financing, to macroeconomic structures of domestic and foreign trade, and to reports on the economies of German-speaking countries. Prerequisite: GER 320 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: GER 320 or consent of instructor.
